quarterly_data.quarter: Nokia press release: Telxius boosts global network capacity and efficiency with (09-15-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Customer Telxius: Telxius and Nokia are deploying Nokia ICE-X 800G ZR/ZR+ coherent pluggable optics (IP-over-DWDM) across Telxius' terrestrial transport networks in Europe, the United States and Latin America, together with Nokia network automation; the release cites cloud services, AI workloads and data center interconnection as the traffic drivers. It follows a joint demonstration (not a deployment) of ICE-X 800G ZR+ over the BRUSA subsea cable.
quarterly_data.figure: 800G ZR/ZR+ coherent pluggables deployed across Telxius terrestrial networks in Europe, the United States and Latin America
